Victoria Brownlie MBE (Chief Policy & Sustainability Officer at the British Beauty Council)
I’m speaking on behalf of the British Beauty Council and Sustainable Beauty Coalition at London Packaging Week. I'll be on the Luxury Stage alongside premium industry trailblazers L'Occitane en Provence and Selfridges, covering all things Great British Beauty Clean Up! 

The beauty industry faces a growing challenge: much of its packaging is difficult to recycle through standard household systems. The Great British Beauty Clean Up is driving industry-wide action to reduce waste and improve circularity of packaging. This discussions will explore what meaningful participation really looks like, from in-store take-back schemes and cross-industry collaboration to consumer engagement and long-term design change. 

Come be part of the movement! 

Register now to catch my talk. #LPW26 #GBBCU #SBC
